question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Once the interview was over I ______ felt light and free.
solution:
The correct answer is '**suddenly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**suddenly**'.
 
• It means** 'quickly and unexpectedly'**. (एकाएक, अचानक)
 
 
• *Example: **Suddenly**, everybody started shouting.*
 
 
 
• The given sentence is trying to express the fact that as soon as the interview was over, the person quickly felt relieved and free.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Once the interview was over I **suddenly** felt light and free.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **minutely**: with great attention to detail; meticulously. (विस्तार पर बहुत ध्यान के साथ; पूरी बारीकी से)
 
• **leisurely**: without hurry. (फु़रसत वाला, विश्रामपूर्ण, चैनभरा)
 
• **hastily**: with excessive speed or urgency; hurriedly. (जल्‍दबाज़ी से)
